{{Quote|Piece of quinberry cake.|Jedi pilot Garen Muln, facing down four Vanqor starfighters|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref>}}
'''Quinberry cake''' was a pastry dessert made using quinberries, or [[quint-berry fruit]], small berries of the quinberry shrub that was native to the planet [[Romin]]. Quinberries were also pressed to produce a very sweet juice—''quin-'' or ''[[quint-berry juice]]''—that was a favorite beverage of the [[Romin (species)|Romin]].

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[mission to Typha-Dor]], 16-year-old [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] heard pilot-legend [[Garen Muln]] use the cake's name to describe the challenge of an assault by four [[Vanqor]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in a military build-up to invade a [[Typha-Dor|neighboring planet]].

On a [[Mission to Romin|mission]] the [[24 BBY/Legends|following year]] to the planet [[Romin]] itself, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sipped the super-saccharine beverage—a favorite of the native citizens—at an extravagant reception for the world's wealthy, hosted by its corrupt tyrant-ruler, "Great Leader [[Roy Teda|Teda]]." By awkward chance, Kenobi also met, then shared the same sweet drink with, the [[Roper Slam|criminal]] he was meant to be impersonating while on the planet.
